name: Stormbringer: Aviana's Blessing native radius modifier and threat aura (#2816)
contract: #2816: Aviana's Blessing (705720) is a passive with two self-targeted aura effects. Effect 0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 6 (SPELLMOD_RADIUS), EffectBasePoints 2 -> amount 3, class mask dword2 = 67108896 (0x04000020), SpellFamilyName 22. Gust of Wind (500932) is SpellFamilyName 22 with SpellFamilyFlags dword2 = 67108896, an exact bitwise match, and its EffectRadiusIndex resolves to SpellRadius.dbc RadiusMin/RadiusMax 12.0 yd. SPELLMOD_RADIUS is applied generically by SpellInfo::GetRadius via ApplySpellMod (SpellInfo.cpp:624) for any classmask match, so learning 705720 must raise Gust of Wind's radius modifier from a 12-yd base to 15 (12 + 3). Effect 1 is aura 103 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_THREAT, EffectBasePoints -31 -> amount -30, no class mask required: ThreatManager::UpdateMyTempModifiers (ThreatManager.cpp:801) sums every SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_THREAT effect on the unit unconditionally, so the aura's own DBC-derived amount (-30) is what reaches that generic sum regardless of which spell granted it. Zero hits for 705720 under modules/ or src/server/ (matching the issue's own grep) is correct: both effects are delivered by stock engine spellmod/aura systems, no module code is needed, and this closes as a regression scenario only.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: no radius modifier on Gust of Wind before Aviana's Blessing
DISCRIMINATING: Aviana's Blessing adds 3 yd to Gust of Wind's radius modifier
DISCRIMINATING: Aviana's Blessing effect 1 carries the DBC-derived -30 threat-reduction amount
